content_of_post_to_comment: How many of us on Substack secretly wish that no one in our real-life circle ever finds us here? How many of whom deliberately choose not to promote our work on our personal social media? We willingly share our rawest, deepest thoughts with thousands of strangers across the globe, yet freeze at the thought of a coworker or acquaintance reading our words.
comment: Maybe the fear isn't being seen, but being seen without context. Strangers meet our words first; people we know may filter them through an old version of us.
